To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the GMRES method with a preconditioner based on the incomplete lower upper factorization of the Jacobian matrix (ILU) is the most robust and efficient iterative method for the computation of inviscid flow fields.
for the computation of inviscid flow fields the GMRES(50) method with ILU(0) preconditioner is the best choice.

for inviscid and low Reynolds number flow fields the GMRES method is the best choice, while for high Reynolds number flow fields a combination of GMRES with a multigrid V-cycle is the most appropriate choice.

the GMRES(20) method is the most efficient and stable Krylov subspece method for the computation of inviscid and laminar flow fields, while the BiCGSTAB method should be preferred in the case of turbulent flow fields.

the GMRES method with a suitable preconditioner is the best choice for the solution of the Navier–Stokes equations on structured and unstructured grids.
